name: v17-redirect-chain
change: No content change. Custom server introduces a two-hop 301 redirect chain: GET /start returns 301 to /mid, GET /mid returns 301 to /, and / serves site/ — a redirectChain.length > 1 violation under test (spec §10.1: url_redirect_chain).
edit: serve.py only — custom handler with deterministic 301 chain /start -> /mid -> / then root serves site/
diffSummary: site/ is byte-for-byte identical to golden/site/. Only serve.py differs (custom redirect-chain handler).
